title: 80% Of Known Animal Species Are Insects
hook: The animal kingdom is 80% insects, not mammals, birds, or fish.
closing: Most insects remain unnamed, so we barely know the animals dominating our planet.
question: Which insect deserves more attention?

segments.say: Insects make up 80% of known animal species. The animal kingdom is mostly bugs, not the creatures filling documentaries.
Beetles may total 1.5 million species. One insect order overwhelms all familiar mammals and birds.
Only about one in five insect species is described. Most of Earth's dominant animals still lack names.
